name: Tuna & Sweetcorn Pasta Bake
method: Cook the penne. Make a sauce by softening the chopped onion in the butter, stirring in the cornflour, then the milk and chopped tomatoes.
Stir in the drained tuna, sweetcorn and half the cheddar, then fold in the pasta.
Top with the rest of the cheddar and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
